name: CGPA Calculator
overview: A web-based and highly interactive application that collects the course information of students along with their Grades in those courses and uses the info to calculate the Grade Point Average (GPA) as well as the Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) across Semesters and Session.
problem: I discovered many students have no idea about how to calculate their Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) and after the CGPA calculation segment of our institution's result processing software experienced a downtime I felt the need to develop a platform that enables students calculate their Grade Points seamlessly and also track their academic performance.
features: Support For Both 4-Point and 5-Point Grading systems (Students can only select one)
Students can enter course details (Course code, course title, units, grade)
Grade Point Average (GPA) calculation for individual semesters.
Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) calculation across sessions.
User-friendly interface with organized input sections.
flow: Users enter their email for account creation and they get sent a confirmation code
If confirmation code is valid, then the user's account gets created
If confirmation code is valid, then the user's account gets created
Users can now login with their username or email and password
Users fill in info and choose their grading system
Add a session or level
Enter course details for respective sessions
Enter grades for the specific courses
Then the software computes the GPA for the system
The results are stored and used to calculate cumulative GPA for multiple semesters / sessions

challenges_solutions.challenge: Handling of multiple grading systems (4-point and 5-point grading system)
challenges_solutions.solution: Design the database in such a way that it easily incorporates multiple grading systems

role.title: Solo developer
role.desc: Built and designed the entire project - frontend, backend, database logic and deployment.

name: E-LOGBOOK
overview: A web-based software that allows users to keep daily, weekly and monthly record of their day-to-day activities, new words learnt and other necessary things in a work environment
problem: During my 24 weeks Student Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES), as part of my efforts as a beginner to improve my software development skill I decided to give, developing an electronic version of our school logbook a try.
features: Allows users to manage (Create, Update, Delete) weeks
Every created week has a journal that stores challenges faced during the week and also the new principles learnt during the week
Users can enter the date and comprehensive description of the work done for each day of the week
Users can generate a PDF report of their dated work description
The dashboard displays the number of weeks registered, number of Journals filled etc.
flow: Non-registered users will visit the registration page while registered users just login with their username or email and password
Users register by entering their email, username and password
Users get registered after validation of the info entered
Login gives dashboard access and from the sidebar various segments can be accessed.

challenges_solutions.challenge: Just starting up my software development carrier and taking up a project like this I had issues with the database queries for different users
challenges_solutions.solution: After testing I discovered that users were able to see one another's log report due to human error from the backend but I was able to rectify it by giving query based on user authentication.

challenges_solutions.challenge: I had issues creating the template for the frontend as my design principles were still below mediocre as at the time of development.
challenges_solutions.solution: As time went by, I was able to adjust the frontend templates and colors to something better off than the initial design but as time goes on, the UI still needs more work

role.title: Solo developer
role.desc: Built and designed the entire project - frontend, backend, database logic and deployment.

name: QUESTION PRESENTATION APP
overview: A web-based application that allows presentation of questions in programs or events together with their options for different contestants.
problem: It was a friend of mine's turn to anchor an event, a contest of multiple stages with multiple contestants and their questions and he decided that we should use a software to increase the fun of it since we are in an era of software
features: Ability to create and handle more than one contest from different users
Ability to create and add Users to contests
Allows setting questions for contestants only added to a specific contest
During the setting of the question, you can enter up to four options with one of the inputs dedicated for the correct option
The logged in user has a page to control the question being currently being displayed on the contestant page
The logged in user can change the question per contestant and also the level or stage of the contest and display questions set for them.
The admin can decide to display to the contestant 50% or two correct options out of four
The admin can also display the correct answer on the screen
flow: Once the software is setup on the host computer, the user proceeds to create an account
Once the user or admin logs in he has access to create contests and contestants
After contest creation, stages/ levels are added to the contest
Questions are set for each contestant stage by stage in any given contest
On the contest control panel, the user controls which contest is being displayed, what level it is and for which contestant

challenges_solutions.challenge: Time Constraint was a challenge as the software was required in a short time and at the same time I was working on another important software
challenges_solutions.solution: Through the development of reusable components and following structured programming principles and guidelines

role.title: Solo developer
role.desc: Built and designed the entire project - frontend, backend, database logic and deployment.

name: LECTURE REMINDER SYSTEM
overview: A web-based application that gives students and lecturers email reminder on the tasks that they have for the day
problem: The need to deliver a system that lets lecturers and students stay informed and notified about the tasks they have such as Assignments, lectures or even practical
features: Admin ability to create student and lecturer accounts
Lecturer creates tasks
Students view task
Tasks have due or expiry date
Students respond to task
flow: Admins would create accounts for the lecturers and students and they get automatically assigned their username/matric number as password
After login, the lecturers and students access their dashboard clearly displaying the tasks that they have for the day or the tasks that are due to expire on the specific date
Only lecturers can set a task and they decide whether the task should accept responses or replies
Students have a button next to each task that enables them perform and submit a task
A lecturer can view responses to the tasks
Once a task is created or modified lecturers and students offering the course will receive a notification
Everyday a notification is sent to notify the students and lecturers of the tasks they have for the day

challenges_solutions.challenge: There was major challenge scheduling the reminders to run every day
challenges_solutions.solution: Created a manage.py command that gets called at intervals

name: UNDERGRADUATE PROJECTS' MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (PMS)
overview: A web-based application that caters for the undergraduate project needs by ensuring a seamless process from the allocation to the supervision
problem: The need to use technology to ease the workload of lecturers, students and their coordinators by providing a platform that allows them to easily interact
features: Ability for Admins to manage all system users and components
Separate roles for lecturers, students and departmental coordinators
Departmental coordinators make set the allocation for their respective departments
The lecturers have access to the students allocated to them
Lecturer-student communication available
Students and lecturers have access to an electronic library of past projects available for use
flow: Admins create a new session
Admins upload final year student data for the session
Admins Update Lecturer record
Admins assign coordinators
Lecturers select their areas of specialization
Lecturers select their areas of specialization
Admins decide whether the allocation is done based on area of specialization or randomly
Admins can reallocate students
Once allocation is done, allocated students are available to lecturers and vice-versa

challenges_solutions.challenge: Handling what happens if there's imbalance between the area students wish and number of available lecturers
challenges_solutions.solution: Ability to let the admin decide what happens by selecting whether to allocate randomly or to just leave other students unallocated

name: SMART AGRO
overview: A highly interactive and responsive website embedded with a chatbot that allows users to ask about their poultry related issues and gives them apt responses in real-time.
problem: The need to provide poultry farmers or other related individuals with real-time responses and a reliable standby solution to problems or diseases involving poultry.
features: Sleek User Interface (UI)
Splendid User Experience (UX)
Smooth navigation through page sections
Integrated Chatbot
flow: Users visit the website through the Universal Resource Locator (URL)
Use the navigation links to access other components of the page or access them by scrolling through
Click the “Chatbot” button to use embedded bot.

challenges_solutions.challenge: Integrating the bot into the webpage. There were issues letting developed buttons popup chatbot.
challenges_solutions.solution: Using the inspect panel of the page to find out the ID that triggers the bot modal and how it was embedded
